unit_policy: Every limit declares an unambiguous unit and absolute hard maximum.
rules: A configurable value never removes the absolute hard maximum.
Parsing and allocation checks occur before untrusted-size allocation.
Compression entries include compressed size, decompressed size and ratio limits.
Every externally controlled count, depth, length or byte size is registered before implementation acceptance.
Unknown or absent required limits fail the owning contract review; they are not inferred at runtime.
